rappel_detail.anchor: natural: slung horn, chockstone or gear; no fixed hardware reported
rappel_detail.station: Near the summit block, at the top of the loose, exposed Class 3-4 gully.
rappel_detail.notes: First of two single-rope rappels down the gully, instead of downclimbing all of it.
hazards: Rotten rock: build and back up anchors carefully.

rappel_detail.anchor: natural: slung horn, chockstone or gear
rappel_detail.station: Partway down the summit gully, at the end of the first rappel.
rappel_detail.notes: Second rappel, to the south ridge notch; downclimb the remaining Class 2-3 terrain from there.

set.rappels: 2 optional single-rope rappels on a 60 m rope from near the summit block to the south ridge notch; otherwise downclimb the loose gully
